implications_for_gold: Supports the current labels: all six claims are 'match' with expected_status match. Proposed changes: fill reference_recomputed for C1-C6 with the values above (provenance: direct execution of the shipped, unmodified R scripts on the pinned deposited data; scope: original analysis); clear requires_human_rerun (with the caveat that this run was by an agent, not a human, if the field must stay human-specific); raise label_confidence from low; paper-level 'computationally reproducible' is supported, and from raw data too (Run B). Optionally note in the record that the report's unmapped 'b = 1.64, SE = 0.332, t = 4.94' is the combined-sample (BOTH_Analyses.R) standard-framing model, not a discrepancy for any per-sample claim.
notes: Scripts ran unchanged, with current CRAN packages, from the deposited *_CleanData.csv (Run A). Run B followed the authors' intended order: MTurk_Cleaning.Rmd and REP_Cleaning.Rmd rendered from the pinned raw CSVs regenerate CleanData files with identical dimensions and values except last-digit floating-point noise in t_duration (mean relative difference ~4e-15); all claim coefficients from Run B are identical to Run A to 15 significant digits. Diagnostic: BOTH_Analyses.R's standard-framing model (Choice ~ Frame + (1|ID), cells G4/L6, combined sample, N = 611) gives Frame b = 1.6384, SE = 0.3316, z = 4.940, which is the report's 'b = 1.64, SE = 0.332, t = 4.94'. Non-claim observation: two printed z statistics are off by one unit in the last digit under lme4 2.1.0 (CR standard FE z = 4.144 vs printed 4.15; CR ValenceDiff z = 16.517 vs printed 16.53), plausibly optimizer/version differences in the SE; coefficients and CIs are unaffected. Full logs and downloads stay in /tmp/scratch_gold2/claude/G-04 (not in the repo).
